_note: The Preferred Vendor List, 2026-09-20. Six categories in the order they render on /preferred-vendors/, and the vendors on the list. A category with nobody in it still renders (Daniel, 2026-09-20: 'show a category with no act'), with its own `ask` line under the heading (one sentence per category, so six empty headings never read as one line pasted six times). Each vendor: id, category, name as the business writes it, location (city or service area), note (Daniel's two sentences, his words only: what they're good at and the kind of event they suit), url (their site; rendered dofollow, new tab). Seeding the first four to six is Daniel's research task on Signet Relaunch. Nothing here is a price, an availability or a count.
